commentary.text: 90+9' That's the end of the match.
90+8' Sergi Canos (Valencia) is booked after bringing down an opponent. Miguel Ortiz had an easy-decision to make.

90+7' It looked like the long-range shot by Victor Andres Meseguer Cavas (Valladolid) would end up in the net, but the effort went painfully wide of the right post. The goalkeeper was quite lucky this time. The ball goes out of play and Valencia will have a goal kick.
90+6' This is a yellow card! Anuar (Valladolid) is not happy with the decision, but from our point of view it was clear.
90+4' Valencia have a chance to score from a corner kick, but the ball is cleared by a defender.
90+3' Karl Hein (Valladolid) is down injured and the referee stops play so that he can receive medical treatment.
90+2' Diego Lopez (Valencia) whips the ball in, but it fails to reach any of his teammates as the opposition's defence averts the threat. The ball is out of play. Valencia win a corner kick.
90+1' Pepelu (Valencia) takes the corner which is cleared by the opposition's defence.
90' 7 additional min. will be played.
90' Pepelu (Valencia) sends the ball into the box from the side of the pitch, but his cross is blocked. Valencia earn a corner.
90' The corner from Pepelu (Valencia) is intercepted by the defence.
90' Cesar Tarrega (Valencia) produces a quality cross into the box, but the opposition's defence intercepts the ball and spanks it away. Good work from Valencia as they win a corner.
86' The ball spins up and hits the hand of Victor Andres Meseguer Cavas (Valladolid) after he fails to control it and the referee blows his whistle for a foul.

85' Hugo Duro (Valencia) blows a huge opportunity! He latches on to a perfect cross from the wing into the penalty area, but sends a bullet header just wide of the left post! The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Valladolid.
81' Rafa Mir (Valencia) has tested the patience of referee Miguel Ortiz and goes into the book for a previous late challenge.
81' Javier Sanchez (Valladolid) is booked after bringing down an opponent. Miguel Ortiz had an easy-decision to make.
80' Here is a change. Cristhian Mosquera is going off and Ruben Baraja gives the last tactical orders to German Valera (Valencia).
78' RED card! Juanmi Latasa (Valladolid) can’t believe it as the referee orders him from the pitch following the VAR review.
78' Wait! The referee makes the VAR signal and he’s going to review that incident from earlier. It could result in a red card, but for who as a number of players were involved?
77' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Victor Andres Meseguer Cavas (Valladolid) comes onto the pitch for Kike Perez.
76' It looks like Cesar Tarrega (Valencia) saw red with that tackle. Miguel Ortiz won't tolerate such behaviour on the pitch and blows for a foul.
73' Sergi Canos (Valencia) takes the corner but fails to find any of his teammates. The ball is easily cleared out of danger.

72' Diego Lopez (Valencia) gets on the end of a pass and takes a shot from the edge of the box, but it's blocked by one of the defending players. The ball is out of play and Valencia manage to earn a corner.
71' Substitution. Marcos Andre is replaced by Juanmi Latasa (Valladolid).
71' Alvaro Rubio has decided to substitute Raul Moro and he is replaced by Darwin Machis (Valladolid).
68' Mario Martin (Valladolid) is being forced to leave the pitch in order to receive medical treatment and his team will play with a man short for a few minutes.
68' Diego Lopez (Valencia) dinks a cross into the box in an attempt to find one of his teammates, but the defence manages to clear.
67' Marcos Andre (Valladolid) is awarded a yellow card. The referee showed him no mercy.
67' The manager makes a subsitution with Sergi Canos (Valencia) coming on for Dimitri Foulquier.
67' Cesar Tarrega (Valencia) pulls the shirt of his opponent and only escapes without punishment due to the benevolence of the referee.
65' Miguel Ortiz couldn't ignore the rough tackle by Cristhian Mosquera (Valencia) and blew his whistle.

62' Ambitious effort from Rafa Mir (Valencia). He finds himself in a great position after collecting a precise pass inside the penalty area and goes for goal, but it never troubles the goalkeeper and flies well wide of the right post. The ball goes out of play and Valladolid will have a goal kick.
61' Ruben Baraja has decided to make a change. Rafa Mir (Valencia) replaces Javi Guerra.
60' Javi Guerra (Valencia) swings a cross into the box, but it's far too close to Karl Hein, who smothers the ball.
58' The substitution has been made. Mario Martin (Valladolid) has replaced Ivan Sanchez.
55' Cesar Tarrega (Valencia) picks up the rebound after chaos in the box and directs a low drive towards the middle of the goal. The goalkeeper, however, denies him with a stunning save.
54' This yellow card was deserved. The tackle by Kike Perez (Valladolid) was quite harsh and Miguel Ortiz didn't hesitate to show him a yellow card.
52' Valladolid failed to take advantage of the corner as the opposition's defence was alert and averted the threat.

52' Anuar (Valladolid) slaloms his way past challenges, but an opposing player does well to get the ball away. The ball is out of play and the linesman points at the corner flag. Corner to Valladolid.
51' Cesar Tarrega (Valencia) brings an opponent down and Miguel Ortiz interrupts the game.
49' The attendance for today's match is 18449.
49' Andre Almeida (Valencia) puts a cross into the box from the corner but there is no panic from the opposition and they easily clear.
49' Another attempt to send the ball beyond the defence by Hugo Duro (Valencia) is thwarted and cleared to safety. The ball is out of play. A goal-scoring opportunity from a corner for Valencia.
46' Half-time substitution. Fran Perez (Valencia) is replaced by Andre Almeida.
46' Ruben Baraja has made a change at the break. Yarek Gasiorowski has come on in place of Jesus Vazquez (Valencia).
46' Referee Miguel Ortiz blows his whistle to start the second half.
45+4' The first half of today's match has just finished.
45+3' Valencia fail to score from a corner as Karl Hein (Valladolid) leaps to collect the ball.

45+3' Hugo Duro (Valencia) is picked out by one of his teammates with a great cross, but his poor control allows the defence to clear and avert the threat. The ball goes out of play. Valencia are awarded a corner kick.
45+1' Ivan Sanchez (Valladolid) sends a cross into the box, but the opposition's defence clears the ball away to eliminate the danger.
45' The fourth official shows 3 min. of added time.
44' Luis Rioja (Valencia) feels very aggrieved after the referee stops play for a foul that he commits while heading towards goal with the ball.
41' Cesar Tarrega (Valencia) performs a sliding tackle but catches his opponent's legs. The referee blows his whistle for an infringement.
37' Miguel Ortiz blows his whistle after Jesus Vazquez (Valencia) kicks an opponent's legs instead of the ball.
34' Javi Guerra (Valencia) collects a sweet pass on the edge of the box and in one movement smashes a shot in on goal, but it balloons high over the bar.
34' Raul Moro (Valladolid) swings in a cross, but the ball is cleared to safety by one of the defending players.
31' Referee Miguel Ortiz sees the trip by Anuar (Valladolid) and doesn't hesitate to blow his whistle.
28' Yellow card. Jesus Vazquez (Valencia) goes into the referee's book after a bad challenge.

27' Abdulay Juma Bah (Valladolid) carelessly slides into the feet of his opponent and he'll be lucky to avoid punishment. Miguel Ortiz blows for the foul but keeps his cards in his pocket on this occasion.
26' Luis Perez (Valladolid) finds himself behind the opposition's defence, but the game is stopped for offside.
20' 1 - 0 Anuar (Valladolid) makes a great solo run and pulls the trigger from inside the box, beating Stole Dimitrievski with a strike into the bottom right corner. He makes it 1:0.
18' Hugo Duro (Valencia) delivers a promising cross into the box, but it's cleared.
15' Luis Perez (Valladolid) is clearly asking for some medical attention with his painful gestures. The extent of his injury is yet to be discovered.
12' Kike Perez (Valladolid) trips an opposition player and Miguel Ortiz signals a foul.
11' A cross into the box from Luis Rioja (Valencia) is cleared.
9' Dimitri Foulquier (Valencia) requires medical treatment, so the referee stops play and signals for the physio to come onto the pitch.
9' Jesus Vazquez (Valencia) is penalised for holding. Miguel Ortiz signals a set piece.
7' The referee stops play as the linesman flags Anuar (Valladolid) offside.
7' Hugo Duro (Valencia) breaks into the box and goes over after a challenge from an opposition player, but the ref signals NO penalty!
5' Anuar (Valladolid) is in a clear offside position and the linesman raises his flag.
3' Valencia quickly take a corner kick with a short pass.
2' The ball is cleared after Fran Perez (Valencia) attempted to dribble past an opposing player. The referee signals a corner kick to Valencia.
1' Here we go, today's match is starting right now.
Valladolid will kick the game off.
Miguel Ortiz will officiate today.
